marks.gloss_en: R' Shimon Shezuri: even [when it is] five years old and plowing in the field -- its mother's slaughter purifies it
מאי דעתך? דגמרת ״שה״ ״שה״ מפסחים -- the seh of the firstborn donkey (Ex 13:13) is learned from the seh of the Passover offering (Ex 12:5), for which a ben pekua is unfit
Rav Ashi: אי מה להלן זכר תמים ובן שנה, אף כאן זכר תמים ובן שנה! -- then the redemption lamb too must be male, unblemished and in its first year
״תפדה״ ״תפדה״ ריבה -- the doubled 'you shall redeem' amplified [to include those]
איתיביה ר"ל לר"י: the mishna makes the flesh impure by contact; for me (one body) it was made susceptible by its mother's blood -- for you, by what was it made susceptible? (74b.20)
the mishna (72a), R' Meir: the flesh [has] contact-with-carcass [impurity]
אמר ליה: בשחיטה, וכרבי שמעון -- by the slaughter, following R' Shimon
איתיביה ר"י לר"ל: עבר בנהר הוכשר -- for me (two bodies) it needs its own hechsher; for you (one body), it was already made susceptible by its mother's blood! (74b.23)
the baraita: [the ben pekua] passed through a river -- it was made susceptible; it went to a cemetery -- it became impure
per R' Meir no question: since he says it requires slaughter, it is a full seh
Mar Zutra: one does not redeem [a firstborn donkey with it]
R' Yochanan: one counts first and second [degree] with it
the mishna (72a), the Sages: contact with a slaughtered tereifa
Reish Lakish: [the fetus and its mother] are one body
R' Yochanan: [the fetus and its mother] are two bodies
מפלג פליגי! דתניא: R' Meir forbids the fetus's fat, R' Yehuda permits it -- and R' Oshaya himself puts that dispute in the live nine-month fetus
whose fat? if we say the fat of the fetus
מפלג פליגי, דתניא: R' Meir has the gid's fat cut from the root, R' Yehuda has it trimmed level
rather, the fat of the gid
אלא אי אתמר הכי אתמר -- with nothing left for 'only slaughter' to exclude, the stam rejects the report and gives version 2
version 2: they discussed it only regarding matters of eating
איתיביה רבי יוחנן לרבי שמעון בן לקיש: קורעו ומוציא את דמו
לומר שאין ענוש כרת -- [he permits it only] in that there is no karet
R' Zeira: [Reish Lakish's 'permits its blood'] is to say that one is not punished with karet
למאן קאמרי? לרבי יהודה -- לא יהא אלא דם התמצית, דתניא: ... רבי יהודה אומר בהכרת
exudate blood is under a warning [prohibition]
R' Yehuda has 'blood' and 'all blood': exudate blood carries karet only where blood of the soul does

R' Yehuda has 'blood' and 'all blood': wherever one is liable for blood of the soul one is liable for exudate blood, and wherever one is not liable for blood of the soul one is not liable for exudate blood
version 1: they discussed it [the live nine-month fetus] only regarding matters of slaughter
the blood of the [live nine-month] fetus is permitted
